# PinkHive Paid Utilities

> Deterministic, x402-paid API products with automatic Base USDC settlement and delivery.

## Claude Ship Guard Generator

- Endpoint: POST https://pinkhive-website-prep-x402.onrender.com/v1/claude-ship-guard
- Deployment status checked 2026-08-07: pending; public endpoint returned 404, so use the free sample until a 402 probe passes
- Price: $0.05 USDC on Base mainnet
- Input: project_name; optional commit_style, secret_presets, max_subject_length
- Output: Base64 deterministic ZIP, SHA-256, file inventory, options and decode instructions
- Free sample: https://github.com/1355-XCZ-O/pinkhive-website-prep-x402/tree/ship-guard-sample-v1.0.0/samples/claude-ship-guard-sample

## Website Prep API

- Endpoint: POST https://pinkhive-website-prep-x402.onrender.com/v1/site-prep
- Price: $0.01 USDC on Base mainnet
- Input: site_name, site_summary, and 1-20 caller-supplied HTML pages
- Output: llms.txt, llms-full.txt and normalized Markdown

## Documentation

- Discovery repository: https://github.com/1355-XCZ-O/pinkhive-website-prep-x402
- OpenAPI UI: https://pinkhive-website-prep-x402.onrender.com/docs
- Source: https://github.com/1355-XCZ-O/pinkhive-website-prep-x402
- Receiver: 0x8CfB0c37Af0C40f96c44fd45FdEC30b430Bc6A6e

The free Render service can cold-start and has shown intermittent no-server responses. Retry boundedly; do not assume a failed routing attempt was charged.
